name: ras homolog family member H

function.text: RHOH encodes rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoH. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: RHOH can be affected by aberrant somatic mutation or rearrangement in leukemias and lymphomas, including rearrangements involving BCL6.

function.text: RHOH encodes rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoH. Based in part on similarity, it is required for phosphorylation of CD3Z, membrane translocation of ZAP70 and subsequent activation of the ZAP70-mediated pathways. It is essential for efficient beta-selection and positive selection by promoting the ZAP70-dependent phosphorylation of the LAT signalosome during pre-TCR and TCR signaling. It plays critical roles in mast cell function by facilitating phosphorylation of SYK in Fc epsilon RI-mediated signal transduction.
